title: rbac v2: enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging improvements
author: Lina Park
description: Motivation: Enforce RBAC v2 constraints for customer-managed KMS keys and region residency to prevent cross-region key binding and ensure auditability. This PR implements KMS region pinning checks in the RBAC v2 policy engine, augments audit logging for KMS operations, and provides a migration path for existing policies. Summary of changes: 1) policy engine: new 'kms_region' attribute with enforcement and audit-only modes; 2) policy CLI/API: new flags and validation for region pinning; 3) audit: additional structured audit fields (kms_key_id, kms_region, policy_id, enforcement_mode) emitted for all KMS-related policy decisions; 4) migration: background job to detect policies that would be impacted and a migration helper that can either annotate policies with a default region or mark them for manual review. Checklist: - [x] design doc (Linear ENG-4012) - [x] unit + integration tests - [x] automated migration tool - [x] e2e test in private-installer (simulated KMS) - [x] docs + console UI flag - [x] rollback plan and feature flag gating Rollout plan: Deploy behind feature flag rbac_v2_kms_region_enforce; start in audit-only mode for 1 week in staged and dedicated customers, then flip to enforce after signal checks. For private installs, feature flag controlled via installer config. Rollback: disable feature flag; migration tool is idempotent and reversible for non-destructive annotations. Security considerations: added strict validation on region strings, canonicalization of KMS ARNs, and additional unit tests for spoofed region headers. Backwards compatibility: default mode is audit-only; existing policies remain valid until maintainers opt into enforcement. Why this matters: prevents accidental cross-region key usage that can violate customer data residency and compliance, and provides richer audit trails for SOC reviews.
